cases.rationale: People are visible on a snowy slope, with the foreground skier clearly identifiable as human. The foreground equipment consists of separate skis and poles, not a snowboard, skateboard or surfboard. Small slope markers do not show an identifiable traffic stop sign or signal; the trees have no pots. I considered all 75 definitions against the entire crop; no other defined object is supported and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real rusted pair of scissors has two loop handles and paired long blades. The adjacent threaded metal fastener is not a hydrant or parking meter, and the surrounding vegetation lacks an identifiable plant pot. These are scissors rather than a single knife or unidentified metal strips. All 75 definitions were considered; no other defined category is present and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The actual walking man, his worn backpack with pack body and shoulder straps, and the meter head and post at right support person, backpack and parking meter. The white red-marked item held beside his right hip looks like a carrier bag, but its obscured structure leaves whether it qualifies as a carried tote/handbag unresolved, so handbag is unclear; it has no identifiable suitcase structure. The large white human silhouettes and depicted accessories on the wall are graphics, not actual objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no other category is supported.

An actual person in a red dress raises both arms and wears a cartoon animal face mask. The mask does not establish an actual dog, bear or other animal, nor is it an identifiable bear-shaped plush toy. The narrow white waist trim is clothing rather than a necktie. All 75 definitions were considered across the crop; no other defined object is visible and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A striped zebra with visible head, torso and legs stands at left, while a long-necked, feather-bodied ostrich stands at right and qualifies as an actual bird. The zebra's distinctive stripes support zebra rather than horse or another ungulate. The sandy enclosure, rocks and trees contain no plant-pot context or other defined object. All 75 definitions were considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The entire crop shows a printed historical team photograph with a title and caption. People and tennis rackets occur only within that printed photograph and are excluded as actual category objects by the common rules. The visible flat printed page has no bound cover, spine or other evidence establishing a book. All 75 definitions were considered; none has an actual qualifying object, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual people stand at a baking work surface. A metal spoon at lower left has a distinct oval bowl and handle; a transparent mixing bowl is partly visible at the right edge. The dark wooden back and vertical spindles behind the child identify a chair. The baking tray holds cookies, not cake, donuts, sandwiches or pizza. The stone baking counter lacks dining-table identity, and the apron prints do not establish actual fruit or animals. All 75 definitions were considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The cropped skateboarder is an actual person, with a skateboard deck, truck assembly and wheels visible beneath the shoes. The silver foreground vehicle is a passenger car; the parked dark vehicle across the street has a pickup cab and low rear bed and supports truck. The red circular street sign is a no-entry sign rather than a stop sign, and the ordinary foreground pole is not a traffic signal or parking meter. All 75 definitions were considered; no additional category is supported and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A helmeted person in black snow clothing fills the foreground and another person stands behind. Their winter clothing and the ski-area setting do not by themselves establish a snowboard, and no identifiable snowboard deck or binding is visible in this crop. Gloves, helmets, snow tracks and mountains are not other listed category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no additional category is supported and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The actual large yellow construction dump truck is identifiable from its truck cab, windshield, hood, heavy bumper and large road wheels. It is not a passenger car, bus or toy. No human is identifiable through the cab window, and the mirrors and vehicle lights are truck components rather than standalone screens or traffic signals. All 75 definitions were considered across the crop; no additional category is supported and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual pedestrians occupy the crosswalk and sidewalk; the central pedestrian carries a small black handled bag. Passenger cars, including a yellow vehicle near the far crossing, are visible. The large foreground signal assembly and the visible traffic signal at right establish traffic light. A pale planter at lower left contains a growing shrub. A small pale boxy vehicle farther along the right-hand street is too occluded and distant to determine whether it is a truck, so truck remains unclear. The storefront awnings lack umbrella structure; no rigid travel suitcase is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered; no other category is supported.

An actual child holds a baseball bat in the foreground, with additional people on the field and partial passenger vehicles beyond the boundary at the top. The bat is not a listed glove category. Small dark shapes at the distant fielders' hands may be baseball fielding mitts, but the saved resolution does not establish their form clearly enough, so baseball glove is unclear rather than inferred from the baseball setting. The home plate and batting equipment do not match any other defined category. All 75 definitions were considered; no other category is supported.
